edges.reason: msg.sender is trusted as the vault factory in __NFTXVault_init, so vaultFactory, vaultId and factory-governed permissions derive from the caller.
mint forwards msg.sender as the recipient to mintTo.
msg.sender is the NFT source and fee payer inside mintTo.
redeem forwards msg.sender as recipient to redeemTo.
msg.sender shares are burned and fees charged in redeemTo.
swap forwards msg.sender to swapTo.
msg.sender supplies NFTs and pays fees inside swapTo.
msg.sender is the from address of inbound NFT transfers in receiveNFTs.
zap-contract exemption compares msg.sender with vaultFactory.zapContract().
msg.sender is the owner checked and NFT source in transferFromERC721.
onlyPrivileged gates privileged configuration functions on msg.sender.
onlyOwnerIfPaused lets msg.sender equal to owner bypass pause locks.
pause requires msg.sender to be a registered guardian.
unpause is restricted to the owner msg.sender.
setIsGuardian is restricted to the owner msg.sender.
createVault is gated by onlyOwnerIfPaused on msg.sender.
setFeeDistributor is gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender.
setFeeExclusion is gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender.
setEligibilityManager is gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender.
upgradeChildTo is gated by onlyOwner on msg.sender.
msg.sender is passed as initiator into the arbitrary receiver.onFlashLoan callback.
block.timestamp participates in the pseudo-random token selection, making it miner-influenceable and predictable.
init writes vaultId from vaultFactory.numVaults().
init sets assetAddress.
init sets vaultFactory from msg.sender.
init calls setVaultFeatures to enable mint and redeem.
init calls setFees with default fee values.
finalizeVault removes privileges by calling setManager(address(0)).
setVaultFeatures writes enableMint.
setVaultFeatures writes enableRandomRedeem.
setVaultFeatures writes enableTargetRedeem.
setVaultFeatures is guarded by onlyPrivileged.
setFees is guarded by onlyPrivileged.
setFees writes mintFee after the <= base bound check.
setFees writes randomRedeemFee after the <= base bound check.
setFees writes targetRedeemFee after the <= base bound check.
deployEligibilityStorage is guarded by onlyPrivileged.
deployEligibilityStorage reads vaultFactory.eligibilityManager().
deployEligibilityStorage stores the deployed eligibility contract.
setManager is guarded by onlyPrivileged.
setManager rewrites the privileged manager address.
mint delegates to mintTo with msg.sender as recipient.
redeem delegates to redeemTo with msg.sender as recipient.
swap delegates to swapTo with msg.sender as recipient.
mintTo pulls NFTs via receiveNFTs before minting shares.
mintTo charges and distributes the mint fee.
mintTo mints vault shares to the recipient.
mintTo calls onlyOwnerIfPaused(1) to honour the mint pause lock.
redeemTo withdraws NFTs through withdrawNFTsTo.
redeemTo charges the combined redeem fees.
redeemTo calls onlyOwnerIfPaused(2).
swapTo deposits NFTs first via receiveNFTs.
swapTo charges combined mint and redeem fees.
swapTo withdraws NFTs through withdrawNFTsTo.
swapTo calls onlyOwnerIfPaused(3).
vault flashLoan calls onlyOwnerIfPaused(4).
vault flashLoan delegates to the ERC20FlashMint implementation.
allValidNFTs reads eligibilityStorage for the eligibility check.
allValidNFTs short-circuits on allowAllItems.
nftIdAt indexes the holdings set.
allHoldings iterates the holdings set.
totalHoldings returns holdings.length().
afterRedeemHook reads eligibilityStorage before calling it.
receiveNFTs validates the incoming ids with allValidNFTs.
receiveNFTs adds newly held token ids to the holdings set.
receiveNFTs increments quantity1155 balances.
receiveNFTs branches on the is1155 flag.
ERC1155 safeBatchTransferFrom executes untrusted asset-contract code while holdings accounting is in flight.
withdrawNFTsTo decrements quantity1155 balances.
withdrawNFTsTo removes fully withdrawn ids from holdings.
withdrawNFTsTo invokes afterRedeemHook at the end.
ERC1155 safeTransferFrom to a caller-chosen recipient triggers onERC1155Received on an attacker-controlled contract.
withdrawNFTsTo transfers ERC721s via transferERC721.
withdrawNFTsTo performs quantity1155[tokenId] -= 1 on ERC1155 bookkeeping.
_chargeAndDistributeFees reads vaultFactory.zapContract() and feeDistributor().
_chargeAndDistributeFees resolves the fee distributor address.
_chargeAndDistributeFees moves fees through _transfer.
_chargeAndDistributeFees makes an external distribute() call that can re-enter the vault before returning.
transferERC721 performs an unchecked-in-advance low-level call to the asset.
transferFromERC721 staticcalls punkIndexToAddress for the ownership check.
transferFromERC721 performs a low-level call to pull the ERC721 in.
getRandomTokenIdFromVault mixes randNonce into the entropy hash.
getRandomTokenIdFromVault increments randNonce after selection.
random selection reads holdings and depends on miner-influenced block values for the index.
onlyPrivileged compares msg.sender against the manager state variable.
onlyPrivileged falls back to owner() when manager is unset.
onlyOwnerIfPaused reads isPaused lock state before allowing execution.
onlyOwnerIfPaused reads vaultFactory.isLocked(lockId).
flashLoan calls the arbitrary receiver.onFlashLoan callback between mint and burn.
flashLoan mints the principal through _mint.
afterRedeemHook performs an external call into the eligibility module.
pause checks the isGuardian mapping for msg.sender.
pause writes the isPaused lock flag.
unpause clears the isPaused lock flag.
setIsGuardian writes the guardian mapping controlling pause rights.
createVault increments numVaults via numVaults = _vaultId + 1.
createVault performs vault counter arithmetic that can overflow in principle.
createVault calls onlyOwnerIfPaused(0).
createVault deploys the vault proxy through deployVault.
createVault reads feeDistributor and calls initializeVaultReceivers.
setFeeDistributor rewrites the fee distributor address (owner-only).
setZapContract rewrites the fee-exempt zap contract (owner-only).
isLocked exposes isPaused to vaults for pause enforcement.
upgradeChildTo checks owner before changing the beacon implementation.
_transfer mutates _balances when paying fees.
_mint increases _balances and total supply.
_name parameter is consumed by __NFTXVault_init.
_symbol parameter is consumed by __NFTXVault_init.
_assetAddress parameter is validated and stored by __NFTXVault_init.
_is1155 parameter sets the vault asset type.
_allowAllItems parameter sets the blanket eligibility flag.
mintTo tokenIds flow into receiveNFTs.
mintTo amounts flow into receiveNFTs for ERC1155 accounting.
mintTo `to` parameter becomes the share mint recipient.
mintTo count local scales minted shares and fee computation.
mintTo totalFee local is passed into _chargeAndDistributeFees.
redeemTo amount parameter drives the withdrawal loop.
redeemTo specificIds parameter selects targeted withdrawals.
redeemTo `to` parameter is the NFT withdrawal recipient.
randomIndex local is produced inside getRandomTokenIdFromVault.
withdrawNFTsTo redeemedIds local accumulates withdrawn ids.
_mintFee parameter is bounded and written by setFees.
_randomRedeemFee parameter is bounded and written by setFees.
_targetRedeemFee parameter is bounded and written by setFees.
_manager parameter is written into the privileged manager state by setManager.
newChildImplementation parameter is written into the beacon by upgradeChildTo.
receiveNFTs tokenIds parameter iterated and stored in holdings.
receiveNFTs amounts parameter updates quantity1155.
createVault name parameter flows into deployVault and the proxy initializer.
flashLoan amount parameter is the principal minted and later burned.
